title: Employee Dotted Line Managers — Create / Edit
overviewHtml:
A secondary, dotted-line manager for a period — for example a project lead the employee also answers to.

It is recorded for reference only: dotted-line managers do not see the employee in self-service, do not approve their requests and do not receive their notifications.

fields.label: StartDate
fields.rules: Required. Date value. Its dates cannot overlap another record for the same employee.
fields.html: What it is. The first day this record applies.

fields.label: EndDate
fields.rules: Required. Date value. Cannot be before the start date.
fields.html: What it is. The last day this record applies.

fields.label: Manager
fields.rules: Required. Chosen from the employee list.
fields.html:
What it is. The dotted-line manager for this period.

Example. Khaled Al-Rashidi (1044)
